sentences.en: For weeks, protests around Minneapolis have caught nationwide attention as the city shows open defiance to a federal immigration crackdown.

sentences.en: Today, our producers Anna Foley and Michael Simon Johnson go on the ground in Minneapolis to capture that effort.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们的制作人安娜·弗利和迈克尔·西蒙·约翰逊深入明尼阿波利斯实地记录这一努力。

sentences.en: And our colleague Charles Homans explains why the city has become ground zero in the fight over the government's deportation strategy.

sentences.zh: 我是安娜·福利。

sentences.en: I'm a producer on The Daily who also spent the weekend in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 我是《每日新闻》的制作人，这个周末我也在明尼阿波利斯度过。

sentences.en: Along with the networks of activists, mutual aid, and neighbors taking care of neighbors, there are people avoiding ICE because they're afraid of getting detained or deported.
sentences.zh: 除了活动人士网络、互助组织和守望相助的邻居们，还有一些人在躲避移民及海关执法局，因为他们害怕被扣留或驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Immigrants afraid of being targeted.
sentences.zh: 移民们害怕成为被针对的目标。

sentences.en: I talked to one of them.
sentences.zh: 我采访了其中一位。

sentences.en: We're calling her Em.
sentences.zh: 我们叫她埃姆。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about the moment that you found out that ICE was coming to the Twin Cities, to Minneapolis?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我讲讲，你是怎么得知移民及海关执法局要来双子城，也就是明尼阿波利斯的那一刻吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so it wasn't something that, like, changed from, like, one day to another.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这并不是那种从一天到另一天突然发生的事。

sentences.en: I think it was, like, a slow trickle of, hey, ICE was spotted.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那就像是一种缓慢的渗透，就是有人说，发现移民及海关执法局了。

sentences.en: Over in Richfield, everybody be careful.
sentences.zh: 在里奇菲尔德那边，大家都小心点。

sentences.en: And then it was slowly and slowly more, agents are spotted here, and someone was taken.
sentences.zh: 然后就慢慢地、越来越多的人看到特工出现在这里，而且有人被带走了。

sentences.en: Avoid Lake Street.
sentences.zh: 避开湖街。

sentences.en: And then it snowballed.
sentences.zh: 然后情况就像滚雪球一样扩散开来。

sentences.en: And then you're really noticing everybody's, like, there's ICE agents here.
sentences.zh: 接着你真的会注意到所有人都在说，这里有移民及海关执法局的特工。

sentences.en: In December, when ICE really ramped up enforcement,
sentences.zh: 去年十二月，当移民及海关执法局大幅加大执法力度时，

sentences.en: Em realized she needed to make some changes and take precautions.
sentences.zh: 埃姆意识到自己需要做出一些改变并采取防范措施。

sentences.en: I start to strategize, like, different routes to get to university, different routes to get to work.
sentences.zh: 我开始策划不同的去学校路线，去上班的不同路线。

sentences.en: And I ended up not going to the grocery anymore.
sentences.zh: 最后我再也不去杂货店了。

sentences.en: At all.
sentences.zh: 一次都不去了。

sentences.en: It's been a long time since I went at the grocery, and I love a grocery.
sentences.zh: 我好久没去过杂货店了，而我以前其实很喜欢逛杂货店。

sentences.en: Em actually can't be sure she's a target.
sentences.zh: 埃姆其实无法确定自己是否是他们的目标。

sentences.en: Her parents brought her to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她的父母在她两岁时

sentences.en: when she was two.
sentences.zh: 把她带到了美国。

sentences.en: She's a DACA recipient.
sentences.zh: 她是“童年抵美者暂缓遣返”计划的受益者。

sentences.en: But that feels very tenuous to her right now.
sentences.zh: 但她现在觉得这非常脆弱。

sentences.en: Given how intense everything has been, she worries.
sentences.zh: 鉴于局势如此紧张，她感到很担忧。

sentences.en: It was kind of looking at what is the busiest cross-sections.
sentences.zh: 有点像是在看哪里是人流最密集的十字路口。

sentences.en: Like, am I going to be going by a high school, or am I going to be going by, like, a church?
sentences.zh: 比如，我会不会路过一所高中，或者我会不会路过教堂之类的？

sentences.en: I tend to avoid that area because you never know.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于避开那个区域，因为你永远不知道。

sentences.en: Are they going to set up by a daycare?
sentences.zh: 他们会不会在日托中心附近设卡？

sentences.en: We have to consider that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须考虑到这一点。

sentences.en: For a while, the plan was avoid risk, lay low.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，计划是规避风险、保持低调。

sentences.en: But over time, that changed.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，情况变了。

sentences.en: She was watching the raids, the arrests, and then Renee Good was killed.
sentences.zh: 她目睹了突袭搜查、逮捕行动，然后雷妮·古德遇害了。

sentences.en: It kind of set something on fire for me.
sentences.zh: 这仿佛在我心中点燃了一把火。

sentences.en: The fear became, like, resentment and became anger.
sentences.zh: 恐惧变成了怨恨，然后化作了愤怒。

sentences.en: I was at school, and, you know, I was talking to my colleagues, I was talking to, you know, fellow students, and I realized that, like, these people have families,
sentences.zh: 当时我在学校，你知道的，我和同事们交谈，和同学们交流，我意识到，这些人都有家庭，

sentences.en: they're teachers, they're taking risks.
sentences.zh: 他们是老师，他们正在冒着风险。

sentences.en: People are putting their lives on the line who have children, you know, who are, you know, loved ones, you know, wives, you know, husbands.
sentences.zh: 那些有孩子、有挚爱、有妻子、有丈夫的人，都在把生命押在上面。

sentences.en: And as soon as I realize that, like, everybody's taking a risk, you might as well also take a risk for your community.
sentences.zh: 一旦我意识到每个人都在承担风险，你就不妨也为你的社区冒一次险。

sentences.en: Taking a risk meant that instead of going out of her way trying to avoid run-ins with ICE, she took routes where she knew she might see them.
sentences.zh: 承担风险意味着，她不再刻意绕道躲避与移民及海关执法局（ICE）的遭遇，而是选择那些她知道可能会遇到他们的路线。

sentences.en: So she could alert activists on a signal chat.
sentences.zh: 这样她就能在 Signal 聊天群里提醒积极分子。

sentences.en: I would see suspicious vehicles, and I'd be like, hey, there's a weird vehicle at the gas station at this cross-section.
sentences.zh: 我会看到可疑车辆，然后就会说，嘿，在这个十字路口的加油站有一辆可疑的车。

sentences.en: Just letting you guys know.
sentences.zh: 只是通知大家一声。

sentences.en: And, you know, sometimes people ask of you if you can, like, circle back.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，有时人们会请求你能不能折返回去看看。

sentences.en: And I was not able to.
sentences.zh: 而我做不到。

sentences.en: I was very explicit.
sentences.zh: 我把话说得很清楚。

sentences.en: I was like, I cannot turn around, but here's the information.
sentences.zh: 我说，我无法调头，但信息就在这里。

sentences.en: And that felt okay.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得还可以接受。

sentences.en: I'm like, here you go.
sentences.zh: 我想，给你啦。

sentences.en: Hope for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 吉人天相吧。

sentences.en: Hope this helps.
sentences.zh: 希望这有帮助。

sentences.en: The network M is alerting on signal when she sees ICE.
sentences.zh: 代号 M 的网络成员在看到 ICE 时会在 Signal 上发出警报。

sentences.en: I got in touch with some of the people who are on the other end.
sentences.zh: 我联系了一些接收警报的人。

sentences.en: These civilian patrols that have proliferated in cities like Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 这些民间巡逻队在明尼阿波利斯等城市如雨后春笋般涌现。

sentences.en: People showing up where ICE is.
sentences.zh: 人们出现在 ICE 出现的地方。

sentences.en: I asked them if I could ride along to get a sense of what they're doing and what that's like right now.
sentences.zh: 我问他们是否能让我随行，以便了解他们在做什麽，以及现在的情况是怎样的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I met up with two of these activists,
sentences.zh: 星期五下午，我与其中两位积极分子见了面，

sentences.en: Patty and Mitch, on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂和米奇。

sentences.en: I came to their house on a block with lots of cute bungalows.
sentences.zh: 我来到他们位于一条有许多可爱平房的街区的房子。

sentences.en: They met me at the front door.
sentences.zh: 他们在前门迎接了我。

sentences.en: But they stopped me before I came inside.
sentences.zh: 但在我进屋之前，他们拦住了我。

sentences.en: Just out of an abundance of questions, would you mind verbally telling me that you're not with ICE, CBP, or any government agency and then show me a press credential?
sentences.zh: 为了安全起见，你介意口头告诉我你不是 ICE、海关与边境保护局（CBP）或任何政府机构的人，然后再向我出示记者证吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm not with ICE.
sentences.zh: 好的，我不是 ICE 的人。

sentences.en: Here's my press credential.
sentences.zh: 这是我的记者证。

sentences.en: Come on in.
sentences.zh: 请进吧。

sentences.en: If you want to take a look.
sentences.zh: 如果你想看一看的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 行，没问题。

sentences.en: My name is Anna.
sentences.zh: 我叫安娜。

sentences.en: It's nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: Anna, great to meet you.
sentences.zh: 安娜，很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: I'm Mitch.
sentences.zh: 我是米奇。

sentences.en: I'm Patty.
sentences.zh: 我是帕蒂。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: After a few minutes, we hopped into Mitch and Patty's car.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，我们上了米奇和帕蒂的车。

sentences.en: Mitch drove.
sentences.zh: 米奇开车。

sentences.en: Patty was in the front, me in back.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂坐在前面，我坐在后面。

sentences.en: Patty had brought along a small notebook.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂随身带了一个小笔记本。

sentences.en: And before we left, they stopped to make sure they both had everything, especially their whistles.
sentences.zh: 在我们出发前，他们停下来确认各自带齐了所有东西，特别是他们的哨子。

sentences.en: I have an extra whistle.
sentences.zh: 我有一个备用哨子。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How often do you guys do you see your whistles?
sentences.zh: 你们多久会用一次哨子？

sentences.en: Every time we see ICE, so that's been probably almost every time that we've been out patrolling.
sentences.zh: 每次看到移民及海关执法局（ICE）的人都会用，所以基本上我们每次出去巡逻都会吹。

sentences.en: And you just, once you see it, that's when you start blowing?
sentences.zh: 所以你们一旦看到他们，就开始吹哨吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 对，差不多是这样。

sentences.en: It's kind of been,
sentences.zh: 这算是一种……

sentences.en: a somewhat informal but accepted, like do a little peep, peep, peep if like ICE is around.
sentences.zh: 非正式但大家默认的方式，比如如果移民及海关执法局的人在附近，就轻轻吹几声哔、哔、哔。

sentences.en: And then if they're actually in the process
sentences.zh: 然后如果他们实际上正在

sentences.en: of taking someone, if they're in the process of a raid or something, blowing the whistles a little bit harder to really get
sentences.zh: 带走某人，如果他们正在进行搜捕之类的行动，就会把哨子吹得更响一点，好让

sentences.en: You're blowing hard on that whistle, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你把那个哨子吹得很响啊，是的。

sentences.en: Do you feel like even when you're not patrolling, do you hear whistles kind of piping through the city?
sentences.zh: 你觉得即使在不巡逻的时候，你也会听到城市里传来吹哨声吗？

sentences.en: Yes, especially in the last week and a half.
sentences.zh: 是的，特别是过去一个半星期里。

sentences.en: I mean, you'll just be, yeah, just in your house or running errands or you'll hear whistles here and there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可能就在家里，或者在跑腿办事，然后就会零星听到吹哨声。

sentences.en: You'll hear cars honking and that's how you know
sentences.zh: 你会听到汽车按喇叭，这就是你如何得知

sentences.en: ICE is out and about.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局的人出动了。

sentences.en: They told me their goal today, and really any patrol they go on, is to document where ICE is, what they're doing, who they're taking, all as an act of resistance.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，他们今天以及任何一次巡逻的目标，都是记录移民及海关执法局在哪里、他们在做什么、他们带走了谁，这一切都是一种抵抗的行动。

sentences.en: To show ICE, they want them out, and they're watching.
sentences.zh: 向移民及海关执法局表明，他们希望这些人离开，而且他们正在被监督。

sentences.en: I am connecting with our group chat to get a sense of if there is any particular part of South Minneapolis where we should be looking around for ICE and actually,
sentences.zh: 我正在连线我们的群聊，了解南明尼阿波利斯是否有哪个特定区域是我们应该留意移民及海关执法局动向的，而且说真的，

sentences.en: Mitch, if you could take a left here and go down to Lake Street.
sentences.zh: 米奇，如果你能在这里向左转，开到湖街去。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Patty told me people patrolling like this coordinate through group signal chats.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂告诉我说，像这样巡逻的人都是通过群组聊天来协调的。

sentences.en: Usually, they'll hop on a group call and share information about where ICE has been spotted, where they think people should focus.
sentences.zh: 通常，他们会加入群聊电话，分享有关移民及海关执法局出没地点的信息，以及他们认为大家应该把重点放在哪里。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people can join these calls, and they don't necessarily know who else is there.
sentences.zh: 数百人可以加入这些通话，而且他们不一定知道其他人在场是谁。

sentences.en: On this day,
sentences.zh: 在那一天，

sentences.en: Patty made it really clear to everyone that I was in the car with them, though I couldn't hear.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂向每个人明确表示我和他们同车，尽管我听不见。

sentences.en: Everyone is very nervous about who might get into these signal chats and be monitoring.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对谁可能会混进这些群聊并进行监控感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: There's a bit of a paranoia and a hypervigilance that everybody in the city has.
sentences.zh: 城里的每个人都有点被害妄想和高度警惕。

sentences.en: Just looking at basically any vehicle
sentences.zh: 基本上对任何车辆

sentences.en: with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 都带着怀疑的目光。

sentences.en: It's put us all on edge, and so
sentences.zh: 这让我们所有人都处于紧张状态，所以

sentences.en: it's not just driving around.
sentences.zh: 不只是开车兜风那么简单。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for them to spot a car that, to their eyes, seemed suspicious.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他们就发现了一辆在他们看来很可疑的车。

sentences.en: We just pulled onto a side street.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚拐进了一条小街。

sentences.en: You just slowed down the car and you were looking.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚把车速慢了下来，并且在张望。

sentences.en: Can you tell me what you're looking for?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我在找什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a black truck
sentences.zh: 对，有一辆黑色的卡车

sentences.en: that had their lights on.
sentences.zh: 开着车灯。

sentences.en: They've got a grill guard.
sentences.zh: 他们装有前格栅护杠。

sentences.en: We definitely have seen
sentences.zh: 我们确实经常看到

sentences.en: ICE agents in a lot of bigger vehicles.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局的特工开着很多大车。

sentences.en: Yeah, do you want to just turn around?
sentences.zh: 对，你要不要直接掉头？

sentences.en: And Patty, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，你在做什么？

sentences.en: I am writing down the license plate of this car and I am going to ask for a plate check.
sentences.zh: 我正在记下这辆车的车牌号，我打算请求查一下车牌。

sentences.en: So you're asking for a plate check.
sentences.zh: 所以你要求查车牌。

sentences.en: Somebody who's in front of their computer is going to run the plates and what are they looking for?
sentences.zh: 坐在电脑前的人会去核对车牌，他们在找什么？

sentences.en: We're not exactly sure.
sentences.zh: 我们不太确定。

sentences.en: What we know is that we can send the license plate in the group chat and then someone will check to see if it has been like a license plate that is confirmed to have been ICE.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，我们可以把车牌号发到群聊里，然后会有人去核对这是否是已被证实属于移民及海关执法局的车牌。

sentences.en: And it's deeply decentralized.
sentences.zh: 而且这是高度去中心化的。

sentences.en: We have no idea who is running these plate checks.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道是谁在运行这些车牌查询。

sentences.en: After sending the plate number to the group and signal,
sentences.zh: 在把车牌号发送到群组和信号软件后，

sentences.en: Patty and Mitch hear back very quickly.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂和米奇很快就收到了回复。

sentences.en: Absolutely no clue.
sentences.zh: 完全没有头绪。

sentences.en: So we've got confirmed ICE for that vehicle.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确认那辆车就是移民及海关执法局的。

sentences.en: So we should loop back around and what should we do?
sentences.zh: 那我们应该绕回去，接下来该怎么做？

sentences.en: Should I park on the other side of the road from him so that he doesn't feel that we're obstructing?
sentences.zh: 我是不是应该把车停在他马路的另一侧，这样他就不会觉得我们在阻碍他？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Mitch and Patty drove around the block while wondering what to do next.
sentences.zh: 米奇和帕蒂一边绕着街区开车，一边琢磨着下一步该做什么。

sentences.en: In the time that took, people had actually already started to gather in the spot where they'd identified the suspected ICE car.
sentences.zh: 就在这段时间内，人们其实已经开始聚集在他们认定的可疑移民及海关执法局车辆所在的位置。

sentences.en: Look, there's already a bunch of people here.
sentences.zh: 看，这里已经有一群人了。

sentences.en: There were more than a dozen people.
sentences.zh: 现场有十几个人之多。

sentences.en: A neighbor peeking out to see what was happening and a gathering group of activists, some in cars, some on foot, some filming.
sentences.zh: 邻居们探出头来查看发生了什么，还有一群聚集的积极分子，有的坐在车里，有的步行，还有人在拍摄。

sentences.en: Mitch rolled down his window.
sentences.zh: 米奇降下了车窗。

sentences.en: You saw him go in the house?
sentences.zh: 你看到他进屋了吗？

sentences.en: Got you, got you, got you.
sentences.zh: 明白了，明白了，明白了。

sentences.en: Word was, the agent had gone into this one house, but people weren't sure.
sentences.zh: 有传言说，特工进了一栋房子，但大家并不确定。

sentences.en: So now, everyone was just waiting to see.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，大家都只是在等结果。

sentences.en: Was ICE in there?
sentences.zh: 移民和海关执法局（ICE）的人在里面吗？

sentences.en: What were they doing?
sentences.zh: 他们在干什么？

sentences.en: Do you want us to go check the alleyway?
sentences.zh: 你们想让我们去小巷里看看吗？

sentences.en: Mitch and Patty pulled up near the alley to watch the back of the house.
sentences.zh: 米奇和帕蒂将车停在小巷附近，以便监视房子的后方。

sentences.en: And just to say, this kind of waiting can apparently take a very long time.
sentences.zh: 而且顺便说一句，这种等待显然会花很长时间。

sentences.en: I talked to one woman who told me she'd staked out an apartment building in this way for about four hours.
sentences.zh: 我采访过一位女士，她告诉我她曾经这样蹲守一栋公寓楼大约四个小时。

sentences.en: Mitch and Patty told me this waiting can make them feel very anxious.
sentences.zh: 米奇和帕蒂告诉我，这种等待让他们感到非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

And basically there's no sign that the feds are planning a widespread pullback anytime soon.
